name: smwsprites-para-spiny-v1
title: Para-Spiny v1.2
description:
A spiny that flies in a pattern like the red parakoopas. The extra bit will determine the direction.
Requested by allowiscous.

Now the graphics routine makes sense and the horizontal spiny hovers vertically similar to the red parakoopa.

Now SA-1 hybrid.

v1.1 (spooonsss):
Add define to disable up/down movement of the horizontally-moving spiny
Convert .cfg to .json
Optimize asm
v1.2 (spooonsss, MFG):
Fix bug where horizontally-moving paraspiny moved up-left and down-right, instead making it move only left to right (while oscillating up and down)
Fix bug where the wrong despawn range has been used (originally used the scale platforms).
